FILE_EMPTY.fix: Download the template, fill it in, then choose it again.

FILE_TOO_LARGE.fix: It can be at most {maxKb} KB. Split the file in two.

FILE_ENCODING.reason: The letters in the file could not be read.
FILE_ENCODING.fix: Save it in Excel as “CSV UTF-8” and choose it again.

TOO_MANY_ROWS.reason: The file has {count} rows; the limit is {max}.
TOO_MANY_ROWS.fix: Split the file into parts and upload them one by one.

CSV_UNTERMINATED_QUOTE.reason: A quotation mark is not closed.
CSV_UNTERMINATED_QUOTE.fix: Check the quotes or save the file again from Excel.

FORMAT_UNKNOWN.reason: The column names in the first row were not recognised.
FORMAT_UNKNOWN.fix: Use the template you downloaded; do not change the first row.

COLUMN_MISSING.reason: This column is missing from the file.
COLUMN_MISSING.fix: Add the column name from the template to the first row.

NO_ROWS.fix: Add at least one row after the header row.

ROW_TOO_MANY_CELLS.reason: The row has more cells than the header.
ROW_TOO_MANY_CELLS.fix: Delete the extra cells. If the text contains a semicolon, put the text in quotes.

CODE_MISSING.fix: Write a code on this row.

CODE_INVALID.fix: Use at most {max} characters and no special characters.

CODE_DUPLICATE_FILE.fix: Each code must appear once. Change or delete one.

UNIT_UNKNOWN.fix: Write the unit code like ADET, or leave it empty.

ITEM_UNIT_MISMATCH.fix: Write the same unit. A saved product keeps its unit.

ITEM_ARCHIVED.fix: Use another code or delete the row.

ITEM_UNKNOWN.fix: Import the products file first or fix the code.

ITEM_TRACKED.reason: {code} is tracked by lot or serial.
ITEM_TRACKED.fix: Opening stock for tracked products cannot be imported here. Delete the row.

PACK_QTY_INVALID.fix: Write pieces per carton as a whole number like 12.

PACK_QTY_FRACTIONAL.reason: Pieces per carton cannot be a fraction ({value}).
PACK_QTY_FRACTIONAL.fix: Write a whole number like 12. Half cartons are not defined.

PACK_QTY_TOO_SMALL.reason: Pieces per carton must be at least 2.
PACK_QTY_TOO_SMALL.fix: If there is no carton, leave this cell empty.

PACK_QTY_TOO_LARGE.reason: Pieces per carton is too large.

PACK_QTY_CONFLICT.reason: The system has {system} pieces per carton for this product; the file says {file}.
PACK_QTY_CONFLICT.fix: Write the same number or leave the cell empty.

PACK_BASE_UNIT.reason: A product whose base unit is the carton cannot have pieces per carton.
PACK_BASE_UNIT.fix: Make the base unit ADET or leave the cell empty.

PACK_BARCODE_NEEDS_QTY.reason: There is a carton barcode but no pieces per carton.
PACK_BARCODE_NEEDS_QTY.fix: Write pieces per carton. The quantity comes from it when the carton is scanned.

BARCODE_INVALID.fix: Write only the barcode; no long QR text or special characters.

BARCODE_SAME_ROW.reason: The piece and carton barcodes are the same.

BARCODE_DUPLICATE_FILE.fix: Each barcode must belong to one product. Fix one.

BARCODE_TAKEN.reason: Barcode {value} is already saved on product {item}.
BARCODE_TAKEN.fix: Fix the barcode or leave the cell empty.

SHELF_MISSING.fix: Write the code of the shelf where the stock is.

SHELF_UNKNOWN.fix: Write the code exactly as on the warehouse screen, or add the shelf first.

SHELF_AMBIGUOUS.reason: Code {code} exists in more than one warehouse ({warehouses}).
SHELF_AMBIGUOUS.fix: Make shelf codes different between warehouses.

SHELF_KIND.fix: Choose a storage shelf to put stock on.

QTY_ZERO.fix: If there is no stock, delete the row.

QTY_AMBIGUOUS.reason: It is unclear whether {value} uses a thousands or decimal separator.

QTY_FRACTIONAL.reason: {decimals, plural, =0 {Pieces cannot be a fraction ({value}).} other {This product allows at most {decimals} decimal places ({value}).}}
QTY_FRACTIONAL.fix: {decimals, plural, =0 {Write a whole number (like 24).} other {Use fewer decimal places.}}

QTY_TOO_LARGE.reason: The quantity is too large or has too many digits ({value}).
QTY_TOO_LARGE.fix: Use at most 14 whole and 6 decimal digits.

PAIR_DUPLICATE_FILE.reason: This product and shelf are also on row {firstRow}.
PAIR_DUPLICATE_FILE.fix: Merge the two rows into one with the total quantity.

PAIR_HAS_STOCK.reason: Product {code} already has stock on shelf {shelf}.
PAIR_HAS_STOCK.fix: Opening stock is only for empty shelves. Delete this row from the file and ask your manager if needed.

CELL_TOO_LONG.fix: Shorten the cell to at most {max} characters or save the file again from Excel.

TOO_MANY_COLUMNS.reason: The row has too many columns.
TOO_MANY_COLUMNS.fix: At most {max} columns are allowed. Delete the extra columns.

PAIR_REVERSED.reason: The opening stock of product {code} on shelf {shelf} was undone earlier.
PAIR_REVERSED.fix: Undone opening stock is not written to the same shelf again. Delete this row from the file and ask your manager if needed.

PAIR_PENDING.reason: Product {code} has an unfinished opening document for shelf {shelf} (with another quantity).
PAIR_PENDING.fix: To continue the unfinished import write the SAME quantity as the earlier file, or delete the row.

import.noRows: The file has no data rows yet. Add at least one row to the template, then choose the file again.

errors.flow_closed: The count closed or the shelf lock was released.

undo.title: I made a mistake
undo.pickInstruction: Pick the record you want to correct.
undo.emptyBody: Your latest actions show up here.
undo.lockedReason: You do not have permission to correct records. Tell your manager.

blocked.SOURCE_LINKED: Cannot be corrected - tell your manager
blocked.STATUS_CHANGE: Cannot be corrected - tell your manager

undo.notFound: This record is not in your list.
undo.howInstruction: You can reverse everything or only some lines.
undo.allNote: The remaining quantity of every line is reversed.
undo.qtyHelp: If you leave it empty, this line is not reversed.
undo.pickAtLeastOne: Enter a quantity on at least one line.
undo.badQuantity: The quantity must be above zero and not exceed the remaining amount.
undo.reasonInstruction: Write a short reason. It is kept in the record.

network.action: Check your connection and try again. The same action is never posted twice.

not_found.action: Go back to the list and pick again.

idempotency_mismatch.msg: This request was sent earlier with different content.
idempotency_mismatch.action: Go back to the list and start again.

insufficient_stock.msg: Not enough stock on the shelf.

location_locked.msg: The shelf is being counted right now.
location_locked.action: Try again when the count is finished.

STOCK_USED.msg: This stock was used later, so it cannot be reversed.

STOCK_RESERVED.msg: This stock is reserved for another job, so it cannot be reversed.

SERIAL_IN_USE.msg: The serial number is somewhere else, so it cannot be reversed.

SOURCE_LINKED.msg: This record is linked to another job and cannot be corrected here.

STATUS_CHANGE.msg: A move that changes status cannot be reversed here.

EXCEEDS_REMAINING.msg: The quantity is more than what can be reversed.
EXCEEDS_REMAINING.action: Lower the quantity or go back to the list.

document_state.msg: This record can no longer be reversed.
document_state.action: Go back to the list and look again.

quantity_scale.msg: The quantity must be a whole number for this product.

validation_failed.msg: The information entered is not valid.
validation_failed.action: Check the quantity and the reason.

rate_limited.action: Wait a little, then try again.

tenant_suspended.msg: The account is suspended right now.

internal.action: Try again in a moment; if it continues, give the error code to support.
